prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1487; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the individual injured in the motor vehicle collision described in your file, and all further communication regarding this matter should be directed to our office and not to our client. Please do not contact our client by telephone, mail, or in person, and please refer any inquiries from others acting on the insurer's behalf to us as well.

The collision was a low-speed head-on impact, and our client sustained injuries that are currently under medical evaluation and treatment. We are gathering the medical and billing records needed to document the full extent of those injuries and will forward them once they are available.

We request that you provide a certified copy of the declarations page and the policy limits for all coverages that may apply to this loss, including bodily injury liability, any excess or umbrella coverage, and any other potentially responsive coverage held by your insured. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this matter.

Finally, we ask that the insurer preserve all evidence relating to the collision. This includes vehicle data and event recorder information, photographs, witness statements, recorded calls, claim notes, adjuster reports, repair and total-loss valuations, and any telematics or dashcam footage. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of these materials until this matter is resolved.
